title: Unrestricted Linear-Circuit Lower Bound for the Discrete Fourier Transform
exact_target: Must every exact linear circuit for the discrete Fourier transform use order $n\log n$ operations, even with arbitrary complex coefficients and ill-conditioned intermediate calculations?

sources.citation: An Omega((n log n)/R) Lower Bound for Fourier Transform Computation in the R-Well Conditioned Model, v5 header24July2014; internal31October2018.
